# `prepaid_lifecycle_event`

Area: **billing** ([all tables](README.md))

A lifecycle transition the worker took or tried for a product on a business date (one per product, action and date): the order it placed and whether the order engine accepted it.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | Event UUID. |
| `product_id` | `uuid` | no |  | The line the transition is for. |
| `billing_account_id` | `uuid` | no |  | The product's prepaid account. |
| `action` | `text` | no |  | suspend (network suspend), resume (network restore) or deactivate (the product ends, network deactivate). |
| `business_date` | `date` | no |  | The business date of the attempt; one attempt per action and date, a refused one is tried again the next date. |
| `product_order_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | The internal TMF622 order placed (null when none could be stored). |
| `outcome` | `text` | no |  | placed: the order engine accepted the order; rejected: it refused it (reason). |
| `reason` | `text` | yes |  | Why the order was rejected. |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | Instant from the injected clock. |
